title: Agent-loop hardening: cut agent ceremony cost without weakening rails
description: Audit of two real agent sessions (dump/agent1-orkflow.md, dump/agent 2 workflow.md) showed ~half of all tool calls were Boreal bookkeeping: a self-invalidating sync/doctor loop after every mutation, inconsistent JSON envelopes forcing jq guesswork, workflow refs that fail via bwrk workflows show, and 20k+ lines of repeated JSON per closeout. This milestone stabilizes contracts, removes self-inflicted staleness churn, shrinks output, rewrites workflows around golden-path commands, and locks it all in with transcript-replay regression tests. Enforcement semantics (gates, evidence, verification, summaries, blocked-until-children) do not change.
acceptanceCriteria: Closing a 3-4 task sprint via documented workflows takes <=10 bwrk invocations and <3k lines of JSON output
Zero BOREAL_NOT_FOUND or unknown-flag errors when following documented workflow/skill text verbatim
No sync refresh or doctor invocations required between mutations; health enforced at gate closeout only
All five child sprints closed with commit checkpoints and green regression harness
